name: tui-craft
description: Design, build and review terminal user interfaces against a captured cell grid rather than against source code. Captures the running app through a pty into a typed frame, runs mechanical gates on it (border integrity, cell-width arithmetic, overflow, truncation markers, glyph risk), then applies a pattern catalogue drawn from 48 shipped TUIs and a cited set of terminal constraints. Both building and reviewing enter the same capture-gate-look-fix loop.
